subject: ONE hyena in a sweat-dark work shirt, long grin, forepaws split with yellow calluses, chest and grin filling two thirds of the frame, hind paws driving the wheel, never held in one pose
second_characters: ONE vulture clerk on the rim a paw from his grin, swinging a bill across the lens in EVERY beat; TWO debtors hauling crates across the lens at his shoulder

props.big: ONE great wooden wheel as broad as the frame, spinning under his paws in EVERY beat; from 7.65 ONE long blank bill on a pole ahead of his grin
props.small: A SWARM of blank paper, grit and torn ledger sheets tearing past the lens

environment: a walled payout yard packed with ledger crates and queueing debtors, top and bottom, no sky
lighting: hard midday daylight, dust in the air, cyan edge left, amber fill right
motion_rule: the frame is TALL and the hyena fills two thirds of its height in EVERY beat, his grin never under a third. His hind paws never leave the rim: the wheel spins under him and the whole yard swings round him in EVERY beat. The clerk, the debtors and the crates tear past the lens the full frame width in EVERY beat. The camera never stops, new shot size every beat, chest-wide to very close. ONE big hero action per beat.

audio.pacing: first word at 0.0, every line said once, last word done by 4.65, then the wheel carries it
audio.lip_sync: mouth to the lens, opening on every syllable
audio.pronunciation: ra-BO-tal ne po-kla-DA-ya LAP, po-lu-CHIL TOL-ko mo-ZO-li i SCHOT

timeline.a: he slams the wheel over with both forepaws, chest down into the stride and filling the frame, the clerk swinging a bill across the lens
the clerk unrolls a bill twice his length across the lens as he shoulders the wheel
he pounds the wheel round, hurling his body down into every stride, two debtors crossing the lens, paper tearing past
driving the wheel on, he swings both calloused pads past his grin and sweeps them across the lens
the clerk flings a roll of bills into his chest and he knocks it over his shoulder mid-stride
he throws his shoulder round and drives the wheel back a half turn, the yard of crates wheeling past the lens, chest filling the frame
he rears up on the rim to full height, grin filling the frame, and swats the bill so it whips across the lens
he drops back into the stride, slamming both pads on the rim, and the clerk and a wall of sheets are hurled past the lens
the clerk swings a pole over the rim and hangs ONE long blank bill ahead of his grin, grit raking past the lens
he lunges his whole body after the bill and the wheel spins up under him, the yard hurling past the lens
the clerk lifts the pole and the bill stays out of reach, his grin filling the frame
he drives the wheel on after it, chest filling the frame, paper tearing past the lens

must_appear: 0.00 both forepaws slamming the wheel, chest filling the frame; 4.65 calloused pads sweeping across the lens; 6.45 he rears to full height on the rim; 7.65 ONE long blank bill ahead of his grin; 9.10 that bill lifted out of reach
negative_prompt: cyrillic words, digits, subtitles, night, dark scene, a hero running at the camera on his feet, a travelling camera, a parked camera, a still or empty background, a wide shot, a small distant hero, letterbox, a horizontal 16:9 picture, a hero back to the camera, a hero held in one pose, a hero stepping off the wheel, both forepaws off the rim, a motionless first or last second, a line said twice, speech after 4.65, English speech
